source_context: Price1997 1mg same six-person crossover cohort; Rosano1997 separate n25 PK group; Komesaroff1998 n10 different population and 2mg RIA; P2-AJ revised manual re-read is same Price cohort, not an independent 4th study.

baseline_assumptions.Komesaroff1998_pmol_l: Measured 0-min mean 89.4; assumed constant for postdose

scoring: per-study average unweighted squared residual for normalized baseline-subtracted group means at all times except anchor; then equal weight over two training studies; 0-min Kom is baseline not a scored datum

family_definition.M1: w=0, k_s ignored; 32 hand-fixed grid candidates; 3 nominal shape degrees
family_definition.M2: n ∈[3,6,9], all other grid rates, positive w; 216 hand-fixed candidates; 5 nominal shape degrees
family_definition.Legacy: production model frozen; zero trained shape degrees
family_definition.FrozenP2X15: 15 candidates were originally selected using all three studies, so re-ranking is contaminated diagnostic only

penalty: ad hoc lambda*nominal shape degrees, not AIC/AICc/BIC/likelihood and not hypothesis-test p-value
